Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Virtual Marketing & Administrative Assistant position at Naturalness Med Spa. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and website management, I am excited about the opportunity to support your marketing and administrative efforts remotely from Colombia.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my skills in content planning, social media integration, and analytics. I am proficient in Canva, CapCut, and other editing tools, and I have a keen eye for creating engaging visuals. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to implement structured data and optimize for both traditional and AI search engines, skills that can enhance your SEO and online presence.

I am highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable with administrative tasks, lead follow-up, and customer communication. I am eager to bring my creativity and reliability to your team and grow long-term with Naturalness Med Spa.

I have attached my resume and portfolio. I am available full-time and can start immediately. My expected monthly salary is $1,200 USD.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Virtual Marketing & Administrative Assistant position at Naturalness Med Spa. With a strong background in digital marketing, content creation, and administrative support, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team and help grow your online presence.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained extensive experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content writing. I have successfully built and maintained client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and Astra, and I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to track performance and guide decisions. This technical foundation, combined with my creative skills in Canva and CapCut, allows me to create compelling social media content and marketing materials that align with your brand.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, a website I designed and built from scratch for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to manage content, optimize for search, and integrate social media, all of which are relevant to the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

I am highly organized, proactive, and comfortable with administrative tasks such as lead follow-up, scheduling, and data management. I have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and I am accustomed to working independently in a remote environment. I am eager to learn about the medical aesthetics industry and apply my skills to support your marketing and administrative needs.

I am available full-time and can start immediately. My expected monthly salary is $1,200 USD. I have attached my resume and portfolio for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Naturalness Med Spa.

Thank you for considering my application.
